citation.journal: Journal of the American College of Nutrition

cited_by.title: Cod liver oil: vitamin D, vitamin A and colds

record.population: Young children (US, low-income; details not given in the abstract)
record.design: Commentary summarising the author's own cluster-randomised study of cod liver oil plus a multivitamin
record.finding: The author reports that these supplements cut winter and spring visits for upper respiratory illness by 36% to 58%. The paper notes cod liver oil is culturally valued and has been a folk remedy among many low-income minorities in the United States.
record.note: Author's own work, with a multivitamin as well; details of the original study not in the abstract; advocacy for Medicaid coverage. Conflicts with the Norwegian trial.
